labels.notes: In find " cat" only because of the cat- prefix: steering gives "engine categories".

labels.label: France (the country entity)
labels.notes: Writes Paris but is France-the-entity: ×−1 relocates France to Germany (Eiffel Tower → Berlin; French → German).

labels.label: cat detector
labels.notes: −3.86 on cat words vs −0.18 on other animals/objects (margin 2.9). Adding to it barely steers; −8 breaks arithmetic.

labels.label: Australia (vs US state)
labels.notes: Opposite poles: + writes Australia, − writes Hawaii. Fires −0.89 in the 50th-state frame. ×−15 → "Australia is the 50th state of the United States" but leaks (Hawaii's capital → Sydney).

labels.label: always-on context neuron (fact recall?)
labels.notes: Fires ≈+1 on every token, static lens is noise, but ablating costs 30 pts on Paris and Tokyo 80→49%. Effect runs through later layers; invisible to blame. Found from dose controls.

labels.label: Australia writer
labels.notes: Static lens Australia/Australian. Additive steering makes the model Australia-obsessed.

labels.label: say a city
labels.notes: Fires where a city name is due (+4.7 at " is" in The capital of France is). Ablate: P(Paris) 70→38%, Tokyo 80→56%. ×−1 makes the model deny the answer ("not Paris", "France itself!").

labels.label: animal-ness writer
labels.notes: −11…−14 gives Golden-Gate-style animal answers; above −13 breaks arithmetic.

labels.label: say a US state
labels.notes: Negative pole: Mass, Miss, Mississippi, Hawai, Massachusetts, Delaware. a=−5.7 at the 50th-state slot; top Hawaii writer there.

labels.label: because (multilingual)
labels.notes: a<0 writes because / porque / 因为 / karena.

labels.label: cat anti-repetition brake
labels.notes: Fires +1.72 on cat words; + pole writes against " cat". Steering it − releases the brake and writes cat at once → "cat cat cat".

labels.label: Australia writer (last layer)
labels.notes: Static lens Australian/Australia; − pole writes reason.

labels.label: city suppressor (London Paris Chicago Berlin Tokyo)
labels.notes: Fires +0.9 at " is"; ablating raises Paris 70→85%. Co-solves surgical-amnesia with L15.N7279.

labels.label: France/Paris suppressor (last-layer calibration)
labels.notes: Static lens France/French/Paris, but fires −2.5 in the capital-of-France frame and pushes against Paris (blame −1.93). Activation scales with incoming capital signal. ×7 forgets Paris surgically (examples/surgical-amnesia.md).
